sectionData.groupingNote: Total assets is split two ways on this page. The lines under Net worth follow where each item is recorded (property, cash and other assets; the Investments register; retirement accounts). Where your wealth is held groups the same assets by type across those registers, so a property or cash holding recorded in the Investments register appears there under Property or Cash and Deposits rather than under Shares. dataStatus.smsfPossibleDoubleCount: Your Retirement register has a personal account that looks like an SMSF, "Family SMSF" (AUD 503,000), and a separate row held at SMSF fund level, "Other Retirement Assets" (AUD 133,000). explanation.personal: Personal level: what you and your partner own and owe in your own names, plus your share of joint items (split equally unless a different split is recorded). It does not include any SMSF, trust, HUF or company assets.
explanation.family: Family level: the personal level plus your entities, shown separately: SMSF, family trusts and HUFs in full, and companies at your ownership share. Entity data stays recorded separately; this is a combined view for reporting.
explanation.jointSplit: Joint items are divided equally (50/50) because no other split is recorded. Each joint item is counted once.
